scenario_name_zh: 多用户下行系统仿真演示

parameter.name_zh: PF 调度折扣因子 β
parameter.description_zh: 比例公平调度中历史平均吞吐率的几何折扣因子：T_t = β·T_{t-1} + (1-β)·R_t。β 越大，历史记忆越长（约 1/(1-β) 个时隙），调度对短期速率波动越不敏感。只影响调度，不改变传播。
parameter.description_en: Geometric discount factor of the PF scheduler's time-averaged throughput: T_t = β·T_{t-1} + (1-β)·R_t. Larger β = longer memory (≈ 1/(1-β) slots). Affects scheduling only, not propagation.

benchmark_protocol.name_zh: 系统级公平评价协议 V0.1
benchmark_protocol.seed_policy: Scenario seed fixed for all evaluations; one Sionna RT channel realization per optimization run

observed_variability.description_zh: SYSTEM-DEMO-001 三次独立完整运行（各自重新光线追踪 + SYS，200 slots）的网络吞吐率范围 130.42–139.40 Mbps，(max−min)/min = 6.9%。同一冻结信道下 SYS 为逐比特确定，该波动来自 GPU 光线追踪的微小数值漂移经 OLLA/HARQ 放大；取其作为保守上界。
observed_variability.description_en: Network throughput range 130.42–139.40 Mbps over three independent full runs of SYSTEM-DEMO-001 (fresh Sionna RT + SYS each, 200 slots): (max−min)/min = 6.9%. SYS on a frozen channel is bit-identical; the spread comes from GPU ray-tracing drift amplified by OLLA/HARQ. Used as a conservative bound (two RT realizations at 200 slots differ by 0.60%).

rationale: 500 slots is the shortest studied horizon whose network-throughput ranking of the β candidates equals the 1000-slot ranking (200 slots swaps the top two, 0.1% apart).
At 500 slots every candidate is within 3.2% (network) / 4.4% (P5) of its 1000-slot value; at 200 slots deviations reach 7.9% / 8.3%.
Runtime ≈ 0.195 s/slot on CPU: 500 slots ≈ 97 s per evaluation versus 195 s at 1000 slots.
Warm-up 0 keeps the Day 5 KPI window (full simulated horizon); warm-up 20/50/100 does not change the ranking at 500 or 1000 slots.
Single run: with the frozen channel, repeated SYS runs are bit-identical (verified), so repeats add no information.
limitations: Absolute KPI levels are not fully converged at 500 slots (up to 3.2% below/above the 1000-slot value).
Without warm-up the initial OLLA/PF transient favours β = 0.99 by up to 4.7% at 500 slots; ranking is unaffected.
One scenario (SYSTEM-DEMO-001), one channel realization, full-buffer traffic, single cell per BS.
Observed variability comes from 3 runs only; it is an empirical bound, not a confidence interval.
